faculty.name: Hector Amaya
faculty.summary: Studies how globalization, violence and new media technologies reshape citizenship and publicness, through critical analysis of Latinx and Latin American media, immigration and narcoculture.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过对拉美裔与拉丁美洲媒体、移民及毒品文化的批判分析，研究全球化、暴力与新媒体技术如何重塑公民身份与公共性。

faculty.name: Mike Ananny
faculty.summary: Traces how journalism's sociotechnical systems, platforms, algorithms and AI shape public life, combining science and technology studies with normative theory of press freedom.
faculty.summary_zh: 结合科学技术研究与新闻自由的规范理论，追踪新闻业的社会技术系统、平台、算法与人工智能如何塑造公共生活。

faculty.name: Jonathan Aronson
faculty.summary: Analyzes international communication policy, global governance of digital disruption and telecommunications trade negotiations from a political-economy perspective.
faculty.summary_zh: 从政治经济学视角分析国际传播政策、数字颠覆的全球治理以及电信贸易谈判。

faculty.name: François Bar
faculty.summary: Studies the social and economic impacts of information technologies, telecom policy and technology appropriation via participatory co-design and community partnerships, from Skid Row to East Africa.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过参与式协同设计与社区合作（从洛杉矶贫民区到东非），探讨信息技术的社会经济影响、电信政策与技术挪用。

faculty.name: Ben Carrington
faculty.summary: Examines how ideologies of race, gender, class and nationalism are reproduced and resisted through sport and mass media in postcolonial societies, using critical cultural sociology.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用批判文化社会学，考察种族、性别、阶级与民族主义意识形态如何通过体育与大众媒体在后殖民社会中被再生产与抵抗。

faculty.name: Manuel Castells
faculty.summary: Theorizes the network society, globalization and internet-era politics, with recent books on the crisis of liberal democracy, Europe's crises and the new Latin America.
faculty.summary_zh: 对网络社会、全球化与互联网时代的政治进行理论建构，近著涉及自由民主的危机、欧洲危机与新拉丁美洲。

faculty.name: Geoffrey Cowan
faculty.summary: Writes histories of American politics, law and media, from the birth of the presidential primary to battles over sex and violence on television, and leads communication leadership and policy programs.
faculty.summary_zh: 撰写美国政治、法律与媒体的历史著作，从总统初选的诞生到电视性与暴力之争，并主持传播领导力与政策项目。

faculty.name: David Craig
faculty.summary: Studies global and Chinese creator industries, social media entertainment and streaming platforms through political economy, production and creator studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过政治经济学、生产研究与创作者研究，探讨全球与中国的创作者产业、社交媒体娱乐及流媒体平台。

faculty.name: Nicholas Cull
faculty.summary: Studies public diplomacy and the historical role of mass communication in foreign policy as a historian, and advises foreign ministries on cultural diplomacy.
faculty.summary_zh: 以历史学视角研究公共外交以及大众传播在外交政策中的历史作用，并为各国外交部提供文化外交咨询。

faculty.name: Christina Dunbar-Hester
faculty.summary: Conducts interpretive ethnographies of the politics of technology, from activism in open technology and FM radio communities to toxic infrastructure in the ports of Los Angeles.
faculty.summary_zh: 对技术政治开展阐释性民族志研究，从开源技术与调频广播社群的行动主义到洛杉矶港口的有毒基础设施。

faculty.name: Emilio Ferrara
faculty.summary: Develops network science and machine learning methods to study socio-technical systems, online social networks, collaboration and crowds, and their effects on human behavior and society.
faculty.summary_zh: 发展网络科学与机器学习方法，研究社会技术系统、在线社交网络、协作与群体，及其对人类行为与社会的影响。

faculty.name: Robeson Taj Frazier
faculty.summary: Explores Black and Afro-diasporic political and popular cultures through intellectual history and media analysis, from Cold War China in the Black radical imagination to Los Angeles community arts.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过思想史与媒介分析探讨黑人及非裔离散的政治文化与流行文化，从冷战时期中国在黑人激进想象中的位置到洛杉矶社区艺术。

faculty.name: Hernan Galperin
faculty.summary: Uses surveys, field experiments and other quantitative methods to study Internet policy, broadband adoption and digital inequality, including links between connectivity and poverty in Latin America.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用调查、田野实验等量化方法研究互联网政策、宽带采纳与数字不平等，包括拉丁美洲连通性与贫困之间的关联。

faculty.name: Jean Guerrero
faculty.summary: Reports and writes on U.S. Latinos, immigration, borders and the politics of belonging through investigative journalism, opinion commentary and narrative nonfiction.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过调查报道、评论写作与叙事非虚构作品，关注美国拉美裔、移民、边境与归属政治。

faculty.name: Afua Hirsch
faculty.summary: Investigates discourses of race, identity and politics across Europe, Africa and America as a journalist, columnist, author and documentary producer.
faculty.summary_zh: 以记者、专栏作家、作者与纪录片制作人的身份，考察欧洲、非洲与美洲有关种族、身份与政治的话语。

faculty.name: Thomas Hollihan
faculty.summary: Analyzes argumentation, political campaign communication, media diplomacy and how media narratives shape public opinion in international disputes, using rhetorical criticism.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用修辞批评分析论辩、竞选传播、媒体外交，以及媒体叙事如何在国际争端中塑造舆论。

faculty.name: Andrea Hollingshead
faculty.summary: Studies how groups share expertise and knowledge and how group communication relates to performance and wellbeing in work, online and hybrid teams, including incivility and human-machine teaming.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究群体如何分享专长与知识，以及群体传播如何影响工作、线上与混合团队的绩效与福祉，包括网络不文明行为与人机协作。

faculty.name: Angel Hsing-Chi Hwang
faculty.summary: Studies human-AI interaction and how AI reshapes work in teamwork, content production and mental healthcare, using behavioral experiments, computational content analysis and qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人机交互以及人工智能如何重塑团队协作、内容生产与心理健康服务中的工作实践，综合行为实验、计算内容分析与质性方法。

faculty.name: Henry Jenkins
faculty.summary: Studies participatory culture, fandom and civic media, examining how everyday people learn, create and advocate through popular culture using cultural analysis and case studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究参与式文化、粉丝与公民媒体，通过文化分析与个案研究考察普通人如何借助流行文化学习、创作与倡导。

faculty.name: Eunjin (Anna) Kim
faculty.summary: Uses quantitative methods to study how storytelling, influencers and AI-driven platforms shape audience responses to advertising, branding and prosocial messaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用量化方法研究叙事、网红与人工智能驱动的平台如何影响受众对广告、品牌与亲社会信息的反应。

faculty.name: Jonathan Kotler
faculty.summary: Teaches and practices media law, media history and media ethics, drawing on decades of representing media clients in the American courts.
faculty.summary_zh: 教授并从事媒体法、媒体史与媒体伦理，拥有数十年在美国法院代理媒体客户的经验。

faculty.name: Robert Kozinets
faculty.summary: Develops netnography and other qualitative social media methods to understand digital culture, influencers, branding and consumer communities for marketing and communication research.
faculty.summary_zh: 发展网络民族志等质性社交媒体研究方法，为营销与传播研究理解数字文化、网红、品牌与消费者社群。

faculty.name: Josh Kun
faculty.summary: Works as a cultural historian, critic and curator on popular music, archives, global migration and Los Angeles, producing books, exhibitions and public humanities projects.
faculty.summary_zh: 作为文化史学者、评论家与策展人，围绕流行音乐、档案、全球移民与洛杉矶开展研究，产出书籍、展览与公共人文项目。

faculty.name: Lynn Miller
faculty.summary: Develops and tests game-based, intelligent-agent and virtual-environment interventions to reduce health risks such as HIV, using experiments, computational modeling and neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发并检验基于游戏、智能体与虚拟环境的健康风险干预（如艾滋病预防），运用实验、计算建模与神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Sheila Murphy
faculty.summary: Studies how narratives and entertainment-education change health-related beliefs and behaviors, using experiments on identification and transportation plus community-based campaigns.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究叙事与娱乐教育如何改变健康相关的信念与行为，采用关于角色认同与叙事沉浸的实验以及社区健康运动。

faculty.name: Jennifer Petersen
faculty.summary: Traces how media technologies, from silent film to code and AI, reshape legal understandings of speech and personhood, using historical and textual analysis of law, media coverage and public feeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 追溯从默片到代码与人工智能的媒介技术如何重塑法律对言论与人格的理解，对法律文本、媒体报道与公共情感进行历史与文本分析。

faculty.name: Caitlin Petre
faculty.summary: Uses ethnography and other qualitative methods to study how data analytics, metrics and algorithms transform journalism, creative labor and power in media industries.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用民族志等质性方法研究数据分析、指标与算法如何改变新闻业、创意劳动以及媒体产业中的权力关系。

faculty.name: Allissa Richardson
faculty.summary: Studies how African Americans and other marginalized communities use smartphones and social media to produce protest journalism in times of crisis, through interviews and archival work on Black media.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过访谈与黑人媒体档案工作，研究非裔美国人等边缘群体如何在危机时刻利用智能手机与社交媒体生产抗议新闻。

faculty.name: Patricia Riley
faculty.summary: Studies organizational communication, institutional politics and culture change, including how communication infrastructure and information technologies shape knowledge management and transformation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织传播、制度政治与文化变革，包括传播基础设施与信息技术如何影响知识管理与组织转型。

faculty.name: Joe Saltzman
faculty.summary: Documents and analyzes the image of the journalist in film, television and popular culture, building the IJPC database and historical studies from silent film to Hallmark movies.
faculty.summary_zh: 记录并分析电影、电视与流行文化中的记者形象，建设IJPC数据库并开展从默片到Hallmark电影的历史研究。

faculty.name: Stacy Smith
faculty.summary: Runs large-scale content analyses of top-grossing films, television and popular music to document inequality by gender, race, LGBTQ+ status and disability in Hollywood and drive industry change.
faculty.summary_zh: 对高票房电影、电视与流行音乐进行大规模内容分析，记录好莱坞在性别、种族、LGBTQ+与残障方面的不平等，并推动产业变革。

faculty.name: Robin Stevens
faculty.summary: Combines digital epidemiology of social media data with community-engaged research to understand and improve sexual, mental and substance-use health among Black and Latinx youth in the US.
faculty.summary_zh: 将社交媒体数据的数字流行病学与社区参与式研究相结合，理解并改善美国黑人与拉美裔青少年的性健康、心理健康与物质使用问题。

faculty.name: Douglas Thomas
faculty.summary: Examines the intersection of technology and culture, from hacker subcultures and cybercrime to video game culture and how games transform learning and education.
faculty.summary_zh: 考察技术与文化的交汇，从黑客亚文化与网络犯罪到电子游戏文化，以及游戏如何改变学习与教育。

faculty.name: Sandy Tolan
faculty.summary: Produces long-form narrative journalism, books, radio documentaries and podcasts on land conflicts, identity, natural resources and the global economy, reporting from dozens of countries.
faculty.summary_zh: 制作长篇叙事新闻、书籍、广播纪录片与播客，关注土地冲突、身份认同、自然资源与全球经济，报道足迹遍及数十个国家。

faculty.name: Marlon Twyman II
faculty.summary: Uses social network analysis and computational methods to study how teams, online communities and organizations form and collaborate on digital platforms.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用社会网络分析与计算方法，研究团队、在线社群与组织如何在数字平台上形成并协作。

faculty.name: Cristina Visperas
faculty.summary: Studies the cultural politics of science and medicine at the intersection of race and state violence, through critical and historical analysis of visual culture such as postwar US prison experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究科学与医学的文化政治在种族与国家暴力交汇处的运作，对战后美国监狱实验等视觉文化进行批判与历史分析。

faculty.name: Jay Wang
faculty.summary: Studies strategic communication and public diplomacy in a globalizing world, including nation branding, soft power, digital advocacy and the evaluation of public diplomacy programs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究全球化背景下的战略传播与公共外交，包括国家品牌、软实力、数字倡导以及公共外交项目的评估。

faculty.name: Dmitri Williams
faculty.summary: Studies the social and economic impacts of games and online communities, including social value and influence, using experiments, longitudinal surveys, machine learning and content analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究游戏与在线社群的社会经济影响（包括社会价值与影响力），运用实验、追踪调查、机器学习与内容分析。

faculty.name: Diane Winston
faculty.summary: Studies religion's entanglement with news and entertainment media in American history and politics, using historical and textual analysis of television, press coverage and presidential media strategy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究宗教与新闻及娱乐媒体在美国历史与政治中的纠缠，对电视、新闻报道与总统媒体策略进行历史与文本分析。

faculty.name: Aimei Yang
faculty.summary: Applies social network analysis to strategic communication, studying how NGOs, corporations and governments form issue-advocacy alliances, transnational civil networks and public diplomacy ties.
faculty.summary_zh: 将社会网络分析应用于战略传播，研究非政府组织、企业与政府如何形成议题倡导联盟、跨国公民社会网络与公共外交关系。

faculty.name: Lindsay Young
faculty.summary: Combines social network analysis and computational methods with a critical lens to understand and address health inequities in sexual, gender and racial minority communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 将社会网络分析与计算方法同批判视角相结合，理解并应对性少数、性别少数及种族少数社群中的健康不平等，并设计基于网络的干预。
